title: ONE-P TMS First Responders
official: One-day rTMS + D-cycloserine to Treat PTSD in First Responders
summary: The aim of this study is to examine the feasibility and tolerability of a one-day protocol of repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation with D-cycloserine (DCS) as an augmentation strategy in first responders who have PTSD.
sponsor: Fidel Vila-Rodriguez, MD, PhD, FRCPC, DFAPA

sites.f: Non-Invasive Neurostimulation Therapies Centre, University of British Columbia
